phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Economic Foundations & Career Discovery — Build quantitative and economic reasoning, explore economics career pathways.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and economics career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to economics career pathways including policy analysis, data analytics, consulting, and research. Students develop a strengths-based career exploration plan.

milestones.label: Master principles of microeconomics
milestones.description: Study consumer behavior, market structures, pricing theory, and resource allocation. Students analyze how individuals and firms make decisions under conditions of scarcity using supply and demand models.

milestones.label: Master principles of macroeconomics
milestones.description: Examine national income determination, monetary and fiscal policy, inflation, unemployment, and economic growth. Students analyze current economic data from the Bureau of Economic Analysis and Federal Reserve.

milestones.label: Join Economics Club or Omicron Delta Epsilon
milestones.description: Research and join a CoBE-affiliated economics organization. Attend speaker events, participate in economic policy discussions, and connect with faculty mentors conducting economics research.

milestones.label: Analyze global economic development patterns
milestones.description: Examine economic development disparities across nations, analyzing factors such as institutional quality, trade openness, and human capital investment that drive long-term growth differences.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Intermediate Theory & Quantitative Methods — Deepen economic theory and build statistical analysis skills for applied economics.

milestones.label: Complete intermediate microeconomic theory
milestones.description: Advanced consumer and producer theory, general equilibrium, market failures, and welfare economics. Students develop mathematical models of economic behavior using calculus-based optimization.

milestones.label: Build statistical analysis foundations
milestones.description: Probability theory, statistical inference, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis applied to economic data. Students use statistical software to analyze real-world economic datasets.

milestones.label: Conduct informational interviews with economics professionals
milestones.description: Identify and interview three economics professionals in policy research, consulting, or government agencies. Students develop professional outreach, conduct structured interviews, and synthesize findings into a career pathway report.

milestones.label: Analyze monetary policy and central banking
milestones.description: Study intermediate macroeconomic models including IS-LM, aggregate supply-demand, and Phillips Curve frameworks. Analyze Federal Reserve and international central bank policy decisions and their global transmission effects.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Econometrics & Applied Research — Master quantitative research methods, conduct independent research, and complete summer internship.

milestones.label: Master econometric methods
milestones.description: Multiple regression analysis, instrumental variables, panel data, and time series methods using Stata or R. Students conduct original empirical analysis of economic questions using large-scale datasets.

milestones.label: Conduct independent economics research
milestones.description: Design and execute an independent research project using econometric methods. Students develop a research question, review literature, collect data, estimate models, and present findings at a departmental research symposium.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with an industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a formal mentorship with an economist in government, think tank, or private sector through the CoBE network. Meet monthly to discuss career options, research opportunities, and graduate school planning.

milestones.label: Complete summer economics internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a government agency, Federal Reserve bank, think tank, consulting firm, or data analytics company. Apply econometric and policy analysis skills professionally.

milestones.label: Study labor economics and inequality
milestones.description: Analyze labor markets, wage determination, discrimination, human capital investment, and income inequality using both U.S. and international comparative data. Students examine policies addressing racial and gender wage gaps.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Finalize professional readiness, complete capstone research, and launch economics career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone economics research project
milestones.description: Complete a comprehensive research paper applying econometric methods to an original economic question. Present findings to faculty and external reviewers. Strong projects are submitted to undergraduate research journals.

milestones.label: Prepare for graduate school or professional certification
milestones.description: Develop graduate school applications (GRE preparation, personal statements, writing samples) or professional certification plans. Students explore MA/PhD economics programs and alternative career paths in data science and policy.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and research assistant
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in economics coursework and assist faculty with research projects. Document mentorship activities and research contributions for graduate school applications.

milestones.label: Analyze economic policy for capstone extension
milestones.description: Evaluate local and national economic policies using cost-benefit analysis and program evaluation methods. Students write policy briefs addressing issues such as healthcare, education, or environmental regulation.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Economics Exit Assessment and finalize career activation status documenting job offers, graduate school admissions, or research fellowship placements.
